tray.restarting: open-bot stopped unexpectedly and is starting again
tray.failed: open-bot keeps stopping, so it was not started again. Choose Restart to try once more, or Show log to see why.
tray.portBusy: Port {port} is taken by another program, so open-bot cannot start. Close that program and choose Restart.
tray.noRuntime: open-bot's files are damaged. Install open-bot again.
setup.autostart: Start open-bot when I sign in
mac.welcome.title: Welcome to open-bot
mac.welcome.body:
open-bot is your personal agent. It runs in the background on this Mac and you talk to it in your browser.

After the install it starts by itself and opens in your browser, where you choose a password. Your chats, agents and the vault stay on this Mac.
mac.conclusion.title: open-bot is installed
mac.conclusion.body:
open-bot runs in the background and starts when you log in. It is opening in your browser now; later, open it from Applications → open-bot.

To remove it, open Applications → open-bot → Uninstall open-bot.
mac.notStarted: open-bot did not start. The log is in {file}.
mac.uninstall.confirm: Uninstall open-bot? The app and its background service will be removed from this Mac.
mac.uninstall.failed: open-bot could not be fully removed: {detail}
